clue.text: Asiatic soon involved in F

explanation.walkthrough: The preamble's F is football throughout; association football is the formal name of soccer.
explanation.definitionFit: Association football is the formal British name of soccer, the game the preamble's F stands for.

clue.text: Ann MP heard making announcements?

clue.text: Name of composer, one composed for the FT

composed as in created, made

clue.text: 10 said to be playing as substitute

explanation.definitionFit: Instead means in place of, as a replacement or substitute for something else.

clue.text: I'm on top of the world and not on the river left inside

explanation.definitionFit: The North Pole is literally the topmost point of the globe, so it can say it is on top of the world.

clue.text: See 28

clue.text: Distance from one form of F

clue.text: It's warmer near here for two forms of F

clue.text: A student in one country finds another with its own regulations for F

clue.text: Replace excellent one said to be picked to do well

clue.text: Opposing permission to enter by force

clue.text: Fate in the same order
